svg.title: Enterprise DevOps Pipeline target architecture
svg.text: Java 21 / Spring Boot service delivered by CI, DevSecOps gates and GitOps onto AKS, rebuilt from Git in each 3-hour KodeKloud Azure playground session
Helm values: image tag per env

g.text: One existing resource group (ODL-azure-…) read as a Terraform data source · no role assignments
ACR, Key Vault, AKS · local state per session
Standard_D2s_v3 · StandardSSD disk · private, reached only through the SSH tunnel
On the same VM: SonarQube container on localhost (heap capped ~2 GB), Docker engine. Credentials only via Jenkins Credentials bindings.
runs in Jenkins today (Phase 0). Every other stage is planned and gets evidence in its phase.
Cosign key as a secret, read by the Cosign stage
Scoped ACR tokens instead of AcrPush/AcrPull:
1 system node pool · 2 × Standard_D2s_v3 · default networking · monitoring add-ons off · same chart runs on kind/k3d
RED + JVM dashboards, SLO and error budget
error rate, latency, restarts → runbook, RCA
kubelet pulls image@digest with pull-only token

svg.text: Resilience and DR: every playground session is wiped after 3 hours, so each session is a full rebuild from this repository.
Terraform recreates Azure, JCasC and job definitions in Git restore Jenkins, Argo CD resyncs the apps. Rebuild time is recorded as the RTO; chaos drills end in RCAs.
Numbered arrows: 1 push · 2 poll + CI · 3 push signed image · 4 bump tag in Git · 5 Argo CD pulls · 6 sync · 7 pull image · 8 scrape metrics
